verdict.rationale: Docs show a hosted cloud API (client.runs.create) for submitting NL browser tasks, an OpenAPI v4 spec confirming a documented HTTP API, and polling via runs.events() with cursors for incremental results — all without the caller managing a browser. missing for 10: explicit first-party webhook delivery documentation (only polling is clearly evidenced) and independent hands-on confirmation of the full submit-then-poll/webhook lifecycle beyond docs and the OpenAPI probe.
